attributes.title: SQL Injection in User Login Endpoint
attributes.vulnerability_information: The login endpoint at /api/v1/auth is vulnerable to SQL injection. By injecting a single quote into the username field, an attacker can bypass authentication or extract sensitive data from the database.

weakness.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command

attributes.title: Stored XSS in Profile Bio Field
attributes.vulnerability_information: The profile bio field does not sanitize user input before rendering it on other users' profile pages, allowing stored cross-site scripting attacks.

weakness.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation

attributes.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference on Document Download
attributes.vulnerability_information: The document download endpoint accepts a document ID parameter without verifying the authenticated user owns the document, allowing horizontal privilege escalation.
